title: Lovely Aerated Venezuelan Beef Braised Pot Roast
description: Rich, aerated, romantic Venezuelan dish featuring vin-santo, braise, fodmap-friendly.

ingredients.name: Pot Roast (2.5 kg beef chuck roast)

instructions: Season the beef chuck roast with salt, black pepper, and bay leaves.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef chuck roast on all sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the red wine vinegar and cook for 1 minute, until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Add the vin-santo to the pot and cook for 2 minutes, until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Add the beef back to the pot, along with the oregano sprigs.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the beef for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until tender and easily shreddable.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Shred the beef with two forks and stir in the chopped cilantro.
Serve the beef hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
